problem: The plugin captured author intent at submit time, after the change existed. Nothing captured it at design time, when the engineer still held the alternatives, the constraints, and the doubts. Generate mode then reconstructed intent from merged code. Once design mode landed, three more problems surfaced: the single plugin could not scale to five modes without one lifecycle surface, the viewer had grown to 4917 lines with no committed way to split it, and Gate 4b, a design per multi-slice epic, ran for zero of the epics that needed it because nothing downstream mechanically required its output.
why_now: Submit mode's intent block already had the right shape. The bundle already held districts and ADRs. The architecture skill held the corpus. Those parts were not connected, and the lite ADR store no longer had a premise once architecture modes became self-only. Using design mode across five epics then exposed the plugin-split, viewer-size, and gate-enforcement gaps directly, so this branch closes them in the same pass.
approach: Merge archkit main into this plugin, rename it cobuilder-architect, put authored source in docs/, and add /cobuilder-architect:design. One design joins N pull requests through an epics array and the branch name design/<name>[/<epic-slug>]. Submit loads that design's intent instead of interviewing cold. The single plugin then split into five siblings under plugins/ with the bundle as the seam (ADR-0016) and shared code vendored by symlink (ADR-0017). ADR-0018 gives the family one lifecycle surface with realization derived from pull request state. ADR-0019 adds anchored comments as a durable ledger. ADR-0020 records authoring the viewer as parts under viewer/src/ with an author-time build, narrowing the build-free rule rather than abandoning it; the split itself is not yet done. The branch also fixed three viewer layout defects, restored markup deleted by a regression commit, retired the Designs sheet into the Designs tab, closed the Gate 4b enforcement gap with a script that fails loud, and replaced three divergent slice-table parsers with one shared module.

alternatives.option: Put design mode in archkit instead
alternatives.rejected_because: The interview, bundle, diagrams, and viewer live here. archkit's contribution is one skill call.

alternatives.option: Keep archkit a soft, optional dependency
alternatives.rejected_because: A design mode whose corpus is optional degrades into a chat.

alternatives.option: Ask which options they rejected, as an interview question
alternatives.rejected_because: A rejected option is an outcome of explore and challenge, not an input.

alternatives.option: Mint a synthetic PR key so a design enters story.json
alternatives.rejected_because: Four readers require a real integer pr.

alternatives.option: Keep a lite JSON ADR store next to full markdown
alternatives.rejected_because: Two stores drift. Architecture modes are self-only, so the foreign-repo premise is gone.

alternatives.option: Leave designs and PR documents in exports/
alternatives.rejected_because: exports/ is the publish pipeline. Authored intent belongs in docs/.

alternatives.option: Split the viewer into real sibling files loaded by script and link tags
alternatives.rejected_because: A published Artifact is a single file under a CSP that blocks every external request, and export_artifact.py inlines data because sibling files do not survive publishing.

alternatives.option: Adopt a bundler such as esbuild or Vite for the viewer
alternatives.rejected_because: It adds a Node toolchain to a repository of prose, Python scripts, and one HTML file. Concatenation of ordered parts is the whole requirement.

alternatives.option: Let a status file assert Gate 4b ran, on trust
alternatives.rejected_because: That is exactly how the gate went unenforced for five epics. A script that exits non-zero replaces the honor system.

out_of_scope: opening a pull request from design mode
pushing a branch or any other remote action from design mode
element-level annotation or a send-to-agent channel in the viewer
renaming the GitHub repository (the plugin and bundle directory are renamed; GitHub redirects)
deciding the fate of the archkit repository
actually splitting viewer/index.html into viewer/src/ parts (ADR-0020 records the decision; the split is separate, not-yet-started work tracked by the maintainable-viewer design)
writing Gate 4b design documents for the plugin-split epics (the enforcement script now exists and correctly fails; writing the five missing designs is follow-up work)
risks: a very large diff mixes rename, merge, store move, design mode, a five-way plugin split, and three ADRs, so a reviewer cannot isolate one decision
ADR-0004 still says ste-writing is off the install surface
